claims.evidence: No shot can confirm import origin or 'UK used' grading; cosmetic condition partially visible but origin claim is unverifiable from photos alone.
Body text 'Canon EOS 800' visible in Photo 0 and Photo 2 (matches witness identity read).
Lens barrel text 'Canon EF-S 18-55mm' visible in Photo 0.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or may have electrical/sensor faults
risks.proof: Video clip of camera powering on, display lighting up, and taking a test shot

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy prior usage despite 'neat' claim
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from a shutter-count checking app or menu screen

risks.risk: LCD screen, buttons, or autofocus may be faulty
risks.proof: Clip showing screen flipped open and functioning, AF engaging on lens, buttons responding

risks.risk: Lens may have internal fungus, scratches, or haze not visible with cap on
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements with cap off, lit from an angle
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with optical defect

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, strap) reducing usable value
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory set laid out together with the camera
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Body may have hidden dents, cracks, or corrosion not shown in current angles
risks.proof: Additional photos of top, bottom, and battery/card door of the camera
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, assume moderate wear

proof_requests: Power-on video showing screen, menu navigation, and a test shutter click
Shutter count screenshot via menu or third-party checker
Close-up lens photos with cap removed, front and rear elements
Photo of included accessories (battery, charger, memory card, strap)
Additional body photos: top plate, bottom, and battery/card compartment
response.reason: The witness confirms a Canon EOS 800D with 18-55mm lens, but functionality, shutter count, lens clarity, and accessory completeness are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
